## 💬 General Discussion

Use this category for general conversations about the Hentai-Senpai theme that don't fit into other specific categories.

### Appropriate Topics
- General questions about the theme
- Sharing your setup or screenshots
- Community announcements
- Off-topic conversations (keep it friendly!)
- Introductions and welcomes

### Guidelines
- Be respectful and constructive
- Keep discussions on-topic when possible
- Use other categories for specific technical issues or feature requests
- Have fun!

---

**Example topics:**
- "What desktop environment are you using with this theme?"
- "Show off your desktop setup!"
- "What other themes complement Hentai-Senpai well?"
